towers.name: Pulse Turret
towers.note: Baseline. Cheap to run — the one you leave online during a brownout.

towers.name: Arc Node
towers.note: Chains. Draw is high enough that two of them force a real decision.

towers.name: Ion Lance
towers.note: Only reliable answer to shielded units. Cannot be left running casually.

towers.name: Shield Wall
towers.note: Blocks leaks. The single biggest draw in Act I — bringing it up browns out a small bus.

towers.name: Scan Relay
towers.note: Reveals air and shielded units. First thing players learn to cut mid-wave.
